name: Paraopeba (Brazil)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with lion supporters and a scroll reading Fides Amor Labor.
history: Paraopeba is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. According to Flags of the World the arms are divided by a blue stripe for the Paraopeba river; the red quarters symbolise faith, courage and work and the green ones agriculture.

features.role: municipal arms with lion supporters and a scroll reading Fides Amor Labor
